# Golden traces are the conformance contract of every target and binding

## Context and Problem Statement

The same agent must behave byte for byte the same on every target and through every binding. We need one artifact every platform can check without a JSON parser of its own.

## Considered Options

* Line-based golden traces: `C <config>`, `E <event>`, `X <expected effect>`, generated by `lake exe golden` from scripted sessions and replayed through each ABI
* Per-platform unit tests

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: "golden traces", because event sourcing makes any recorded session a test, the format needs only line splitting and string comparison, and the same files serve C, Swift, Kotlin, the Lean driver and live runs (a run against a real model can be recorded and replayed).

### Consequences

* Good, because a behaviour change shows up as a diff in `traces/` and CI fails until it is regenerated deliberately.
* Bad, because harmless output changes (for example a reworded error) require regenerating the traces.

## More Information

Capabilities `openspec:portable-build` and `openspec:host-abi`.
